difficulty.heading: Campaign difficulty

story.name: Story
story.detail: More time and supplies. Auto Turn can carry routine operations.

commander.name: Commander
commander.detail: Fair enemy action economy. Objectives must survive a counterattack.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.detail: Sharper opposition, reinforcements, fewer supplies, and a tighter war clock.

settings.title: Settings

manual.title: Commander Manual
manual.intro: The essentials for keeping your force alive and the invasion moving east.

lines.0: Choose an available sector before its turn clock expires.
lines.1: Recruit, refill, and research between operations; new units may need a turn to arrive.
lines.2: Launch one operation per strategic turn, then end the turn to advance the war clock.

lines.0: Reposition squads on the glowing deployment tiles, then start the battle.
lines.1: Select a unit and click a reachable tile to move. Select a visible enemy to prepare fire.
lines.2: Action points pay for movement and attacks; ammunition does not refill by itself.

lines.0: Drag or use the arrow keys to pan, and use the mouse wheel to zoom.
lines.1: Tab toggles the minimap; H, F1, or ? opens the battlefield help.
lines.2: Overwatch spends the rest of a unit's turn to fire at enemies that move into sight.

lines.0: Cover, elevation, flanking, morale, weather, and wounds all change combat odds.
lines.1: Use medics for wounded troops and supply vehicles for finite-ammo units.
lines.2: Retreat is safer from the starting zone; squads left outside it may be lost.

lines.0: A ready unit may suppress once per turn: PIN -N means morale lost, and low morale can suppress or route troops.
lines.1: Critical mission actions need the named specialist beside the objective by the shown round; bonus objectives are optional.
lines.2: Deploying or packing radar spends its remaining turn; deployed radar sees farther but cannot move.

lines.0: A unit serves in only one task group; its formation bonus follows that assignment.
lines.1: An officer's aura reaches the task group only when the officer's carrier deploys with it.
lines.2: Eligible units can fit one researched package in each offense, protection, and mobility slot; every package has a trade-off.
